title: Volume 1 Chapter 3: A Strange Illness and Androphobia (Fear of Men)
content: Several days had passed since the subjugation of the venomous snakes.
I was idly spending my time in the medical room as usual. However, there had been some changes.
“Lord Salt, please take care of this one.”
Freina had been coming to the medical room more frequently, bringing along injured members.
The ones she brought seemed to have let go of their previous reservations and casually greeted me.
“Please, Salt-sensei!”
One of the female knights peeked her head in.
Until recently, even though they knew I was here, no one had come to seek treatment.
But these past few days were different.
The female knights who participated in the snake subjugation had started coming to the medical room whenever they needed herbs for their injuries.
“What’s wrong? Are you feeling unwell?”
I stood up to greet Freina and the knights.
“No, I just twisted my ankle a bit. I might have overdone it during the snake subjugation.”
She smiled shyly, but behind that smile, I could see her trust in me.
Just a few days ago, they had doubts about my presence here, but now they casually dropped by the medical room.
After I risked my life to save Freina, they began to trust me as a comrade.
Moreover, they had been talking to other members who hadn’t participated, so the cold stares and attitudes filled with disdain had decreased.
“Well then, let’s take a look.”
I carefully examined her ankle and used a light healing magic to help her recover.
She quickly stood up and smiled brightly.
“As expected of Salt-sensei! I’m all better already! Thank you!”
“It’s nothing. Just be careful.”
“Yes!”
She left with a beaming smile.
Since there were many young female members, I decided to have them call me “sensei” to maintain a certain distance.
“Thanks for everything. I’ll come again.”
“Likewise, please take care, Lady Freina.”
After seeing Freina off, I recalled memories from my previous life.
Why was I drawing a line between doctor and patient?
I felt that if I didn’t set that boundary within myself, impure feelings might start to sprout.
After that, more and more members came to the medical room one after another.
Everyone had witnessed my actions when Freina was poisoned, and that must have moved their hearts.
“Salt-san, was someone else here again?”
“It’s you, May. Good to see you.”
“Excuse me! As long as Salt-san is in the medical room, it’s always lively!”
“I appreciate everyone coming, but I’m not special or anything.”
I patted her head. May’s small stature made it easy to reach her head, and I couldn’t help but extend my hand.
“Nufoo!
You’re being too modest!
Salt-san is a hero who saved Lady Freina and single-handedly defeated the venomous snake!”
“No, that’s a bit exaggerated.”
“What’s exaggerated about it? If it weren’t for Salt-san, Lady Freina and everyone would be in serious trouble!”
May’s cheerful demeanor was a bit of a relief for me. However, that peaceful time didn’t last long.
One evening, Freina entered the medical room with a serious expression.
“Lord Salt, do you have a moment?”
“What’s wrong, Lady Freina?”
Freina hesitated, wearing a troubled expression as she spoke.
“Actually, we’ve received a complaint from the Healers Guild.”
“A complaint...? About me?”
“Yeah.
It’s wonderful that the members have started to trust you and come to the medical room, but it seems that this has led to a decrease in patients for the Healers Guild.
It appears to be quite a blow for them.”
I frowned slightly. A complaint from the Healers Guild was unexpected.
I had only acted out of a desire to heal those in front of me.
I hadn’t realized that my actions were causing trouble for the guild.
“I see... I didn’t mean to cause any trouble for the Healers Guild.”
“No, it’s not your fault.
Both Lady Rana and I support your continued treatment here.
However, the people from the Healers Guild probably have their grievances.
They feel that their treatment space is being monopolized.”
“...What should we do?”
“Don’t worry about it.
As long as the members trust you, we’ll prioritize that.
We’ll handle the negotiations with the Healers Guild, so you just focus on treating the members as you have been.”
Freina lightly patted my shoulder, but I still felt a bit heavy in my heart.
I was glad to be trusted by the members. However, I was concerned about the friction with the Healers Guild.
My existence was unintentionally affecting others.
I was once again struck by the anxiety that my place might become unstable.
“Well, I guess I can only continue doing what I can…”
As I told myself that, I decided to concentrate on treating the members who continued to come to the medical room.
Although I was concerned about what Freina had reported, I continued to do my job.
After finishing my duties for the day, I headed to Lady Rana’s office.
I was required to regularly report to Lady Rana and Freina about the members' health and work.
When I entered the office, Lady Rana was at her desk, sorting through documents.
Today, she was dressed in a shirt and glasses, giving off the vibe of a capable woman, with her hair tied up, making her look different.
She resembled a career woman from my previous life, exuding elegance and grace in her work.
However, my gaze was naturally drawn to her ample bosom, which was accentuated by her shirt resting on the desk, but I was careful not to look away from her face as soon as I entered the room.
After hearing about her fear of men during a drinking session, I made it a point to avoid getting too close or looking anywhere but into her eyes.
She was not just a lord but also an important figure for me as my employer.
Freina stood by her side, wearing a wry smile at my attitude.
“Excuse me. It’s Salt. I’ve come for my regular report.”
As I said that, Freina nodded lightly with her arms crossed.
“Yes, please go ahead.”
Hearing Lady Rana’s voice, Freina turned her gaze to her.
For just a moment, Lady Rana’s shoulder twitched.
If I hadn’t heard about her fear of men, I wouldn’t have noticed such a subtle movement.
She must have been stiffened by the gazes of many men before.
“How have things been? Is everything going smoothly lately?”
Freina kindly initiated the conversation.
“Yes, thanks to you, the members have started to trust me.
They’ve been coming in for treatment, and everything is going well.”
“Yes, Salt-san is also the lifesaver of Freina. I look forward to your continued support.”
“I truly appreciate Lord Salt.”
“It was just a matter of being compatible with the monsters.”
Since miasma had been rampant, I was able to prove my usefulness.
It was just luck that I was able to accompany the patrol.
Freina must have been considerate in that regard.
“By the way, it seems you’re being called ‘sensei’ by the members.”
“Haha, since there are many young women, it’s a way to draw a line between us.
I’m reminding myself to treat them as a healer.”
“Well, that’s quite gentlemanly of you.”
“Ah, it’s just that my heart is weak.”
When I spoke with determination, Lady Rana, who could talk without showing her fear of men, must have had many experiences.
...Knock, knock.
While I was reporting, there was a knock on the office door.
Freina nodded, and I opened the door. On the other side stood a woman in a white coat with long green hair.
“I’m Aria Narvel from the Healers Guild. I’ve come for Lady Rana’s regular examination.”
Her quiet voice was both intelligent and beautiful. The gaze directed at me felt chilling.
“I don’t understand why there’s a man in the office, but I’m responsible for Lady Rana’s health management.
Please leave.”
Aria continued with a glare.
“Aria, don’t speak like that. This person is the dedicated healer for the Fourth Knight Order, known as Salt.”
“Oh, so you’re the trainee healer who boldly infiltrated a female knight order, taking advantage of your holy attribute.
I’m Aria Narvel, a healer affiliated with the Healers Guild.”
I was somewhat overwhelmed by Aria’s sharp words, but I couldn’t remain silent after she introduced herself.
“I’m Salt, an adventurer. Currently, I’m a temporary healer for the Fourth Knight Order.”
Though awkward, I managed to finish my introduction.
However, her gaze suddenly shifted away as if she had lost interest.
“Protecting Lady Rana’s health is my responsibility. Please leave.”
Her words were sharp, and I felt a tightening sensation in my chest.
It was clear that I was seen as an unnecessary presence.
“Now, now, Aria, don’t be so prickly. Salt-san has been doing well.”
Lady Rana gently tried to soothe her, but Aria’s attitude remained unchanged.
“However, Lady Rana…”
As Aria began to speak, Lady Rana’s face suddenly turned pale, and her body swayed.
“Lady Rana!”
I was startled and tried to rush to her, but Aria was quicker, supporting her shoulder.
Lady Rana leaned against Aria, but her eyes were faintly trembling.
“What is this…!”
Aria immediately began preparing for an examination, but her expression showed signs of panic.
“Male, you need to leave right now!”
As she reached for Lady Rana’s clothes, Aria ordered me sharply.
Understanding the situation, I dashed out of the office.
I was left speechless at the sight of Lady Rana in distress.
I couldn’t believe she had collapsed so suddenly… Even after closing the door, the image of Lady Rana’s suffering remained burned into my mind.
I learned of Aria’s examination results from Freina’s report.
Finally, I felt a weight lift from my chest.
When Lady Rana collapsed, I truly thought my heart would freeze, but Aria diagnosed her as being fatigued and performed healing magic, which helped her condition recover.
“Now I can breathe easy.”
I murmured to myself. However, I couldn’t shake the concern about her complexion when she collapsed.
“Can’t I examine her?”
“What’s wrong?”
“I’m just a bit concerned.”
“Concerned about what?”
“Well, when Lady Rana collapsed, her complexion seemed to turn a bit purple.”
“Purple?”
“It might have just been a shadow.”
Freina thought for a moment but shook her head.
“I’m sorry, Lord Salt.
I’m not doubting you, especially since you saved me.
However, Aria has been Lady Rana’s personal doctor since childhood and has been monitoring her health.
The three of us have built trust as peers.”
With Freina’s response, I stopped trying to say more.
“I’m not trying to push. I’m just concerned.”
Freina’s face seemed to show a hint of unease.
“I trust that Aria has examined her and found no issues. Lady Rana might just be overexerting herself.”
“That’s true. It’s undeniable that Lady Rana is under a lot of strain. We need to support her more.”
I agreed with Freina’s words. With the friction with the Healers Guild, my options were limited.
While I was in the medical room, knights would inevitably come in.
So, I decided to accompany the knights on their expedition.
Since the last patrol, when Freina was poisoned, she had dedicated herself to protecting Lady Rana.
Therefore, Krush had been taking command more frequently.
Since Krush had no attribute, she couldn’t cast magic.
I often accompanied the expedition as a holy attribute user, and each time, I had been carrying out missions alongside Krush and May.
Fighting alongside them and deepening our trust made me feel the bond with the knights grow stronger.
One day, after returning from an expedition, I headed to Lady Rana’s office for my regular report.
Since Freina was also serving as Lady Rana’s guard, I wasn’t particularly worried, but the moment I opened the office door, a sense of discomfort washed over me.
“...Lady Rana?”
I instinctively called out in a hushed voice.
Lady Rana’s complexion was clearly poor.
Her pale skin and somewhat lifeless eyes made her look like a completely different person from the usually calm, energetic, and beautiful woman I knew.
“Salt-san… you came.”
Lady Rana greeted me in a hoarse voice, but there was none of her usual dignity or kindness in it.
She looked clearly unwell.
“Lady Rana, are you okay?”
I instinctively tried to step closer.
At that moment, Freina stood up with a serious expression.
“Lord Salt!”
Freina’s warning made me stop in my tracks, halting my approach to Lady Rana.
“Aria has been coming to examine her every day, but her symptoms aren’t improving.
She’s doing her best, but we still don’t know the cause.”
I couldn’t hide my surprise at those words.
The healing attribute is said to have the power to restore abnormalities in people and living beings.
Additionally, Aria is an excellent healer within the Healers Guild.
If even she couldn’t find any improvement, there might be another underlying cause.
“Lord Salt, is there anything you can discern with your power? Can you diagnose Lady Rana’s condition?”
Freina, who had been listening to the previous offer, asked anxiously.
“Of course, I want to do whatever I can. But…”
I glanced at Lady Rana. She stiffened as if frightened by my gaze.
I had known about Lady Rana’s fear of men for some time, but I hadn’t expected her to react so strongly.
“Lady Rana, may I examine you? I might be able to help.”
I gently asked, trying not to scare her.
However, Lady Rana wore a troubled expression and shook her head.
“No… I’m sorry… I just can’t…”
At that moment, Aria entered the room with her examination tools in hand.
Her cold gaze pierced through me.
“Salt-san, please refrain from any further actions.
This is my job.
I’m responsible for Lady Rana’s examination.
Your interference is unnecessary.”
Aria’s words were harsh, clearly showing her rejection.
She disliked having her territory invaded.
Moreover, knowing about Lady Rana’s fear of men, she likely thought my involvement would be counterproductive.
“I understand… I’m sorry.”
I replied, slightly dejected. I was frustrated that my options were limited, but I couldn’t force the issue.
As Lady Rana’s condition worsened, I stood there helplessly.
A few days into the expedition, the Fourth Knight Order’s team was advancing through a forest filled with miasma.
The air was damp, and the entire forest was shrouded in a heavy atmosphere.
The faint light filtering through the trees seemed to be blocked by the miasma, appearing hazy.
“Everyone, stay alert!”
Krush called out to the members ahead. Her sharp gaze allowed no room for error.
“It’s okay! We’ll keep moving forward!”
May’s bright voice encouraged the members, but a hint of tension was evident on her face.
I had never realized how terrifying an unseen enemy could be.
The miasma was overflowing.
Yet, the monsters were nowhere to be seen.
Only the drifting mist seemed to dominate the forest.
I too felt an ominous presence creeping up behind us.
This miasma was different from just natural toxins. It felt as if it wrapped around us like a living creature.
“Krush, May, be careful. This miasma isn’t normal… It’s as if it has a will of its own.”
I warned them while cautiously scanning the surroundings.
“I know. Don’t let your guard down.”
Krush instructed everyone to gather their magic power and communicated the countermeasures against the mist.
But then it happened.
“Ugh…!”
Suddenly, a groan came from behind.
When I turned around, I saw a member kneeling and struggling.
Their complexion was clearly off.
Instead of pale, it was turning purple.
“What is this…!”
Lady Rana’s face suddenly flashed in my mind.
It resembled how she looked when she collapsed.
Moreover, memories from the past resurfaced.
I had encountered this symptom before.
“Everyone, get away! Get out of the forest!”
I shouted as I rushed toward the fallen member.
The other knights, being warriors of the order, quickly distanced themselves calmly.
However, the fallen member wasn’t the only one.
One after another, members began to collapse, their faces turning purple. Witnessing this, my heart froze.
“Krush, May! Get the fallen out of the forest. It’s the mist! This mist is the monster!”
I looked at them, but the two stood firm without showing any signs of collapsing.
“What! Understood. May, those who can move, retreat from the forest. Help those who can’t!”
“Are you two okay?”
“Yeah, we’re fine.”
“I’m okay too!”
By the time we got out of the forest, everyone except Krush and May had collapsed, their faces turning purple.
“Lord Salt, what is happening?”
“It’s cursed poison.”
“What is cursed poison? What is that?”
“The miasma is of the death attribute, and it can mutate monsters and plants.
You know that monsters can be born from it.”
“Yeah, I know that.”
I began purifying those we had managed to get outside the forest.
“Cursed poison refers to the miasma taking over microorganisms, small creatures, and causing harm within the body.
Unlike regular monsters, it’s too small to notice and doesn’t cause immediate harm.
It multiplies inside the body and gradually worsens the symptoms.”
“So everyone displayed symptoms all at once because they inhaled a large amount?”
“Yeah, that’s right.”
Moreover, this cursed poison isn’t from a strong monster.
Once someone is parasitized by cursed poison, purifying it with holy attributes significantly reduces the risk of being re-parasitized.
This had already been tested with Asha.
“So, we’re safe because we were purified by you before, Lord Salt?”
“It’s thanks to being purified during the battle with the White King! We owe it to you, Salt-san! Nufoo!”
May’s face beamed with pride.
They had been affected by cursed poison at that time.
And the others who had gone on the expedition had also been purified in my medical room.
However, there was one woman who hadn’t received my purification after the battle with the White King.
I understood the cause of Lady Rana’s health issues.
“Krush, this forest is dangerous. We must purify it immediately.”
“Yeah, that’s right.”
“It will be difficult for those who have fallen to move right away.
Since they have been purified, let’s transport them to a nearby village to rest.”
“Understood!”
We loaded as many members as possible onto the cart that had brought them and transported them to the village.
After securing the safety of the members with the help of the villagers, I drew a magic circle in front of the forest.
Even if I cast purification on the mist monster, it would quickly reappear.
That’s why I needed to purify the entire forest.
“Lord Salt, are you okay?”
“I don’t know.
But I’ll use a magic enhancement potion, and this time I’ll also use the magic circle as a medium.
I should be able to minimize magic consumption.
Plus, once this is done, I need to help Lady Rana.”
“Ah, you’re amazing! My benefactor is incredible. If you need anything, just let me know.”
“Thank you, Krush.”
“I told you to just call me Krush.”
“Then I’ll call you Salt. I won’t be able to move while casting magic, so I’ll rely on your protection.”
“I’m sorry. I can’t call my benefactor by their name.”
“I’ll also be here!”
I entrusted the members who could still move to May, who would rest in the village, and had the two lively ones, Krush and May, protect me.
I completed the magic circle, creating a massive pentagram in the sky.
“Holy talisman!”
The members had collapsed due to the miasma that produced this cursed poison.
Having been exposed to the miasma for an extended period, the death poison seeped into their bodies.
“I need to hurry… If this continues, everyone will be in danger!”
I couldn’t let it spread any further, not just for the village but for the entire Corias Territory.
“《Holy Purification! Sanctuary!》”
Five swords descended from the sky, piercing the outer edge of the forest, creating a sanctuary.
“Lord Salt!”
“Salt-san!”
I heard Krush and May’s voices. I knew. My magic power wasn’t enough.
“Lord Salt, I’m sorry!”
Krush kissed me on the lips. In that instant, magic power flowed into me, and the spell was completed in an instant.
“Use my useless magic power.”
The beautiful woman with silver hair and pure white skin smiled at me.
“Ah, leave it to me.”
I poured the final magic power needed to purify the entire forest.
The miasma that had been the source of the cursed poison vanished completely.
The air in the forest changed from the stagnant miasma to a refreshing one.
“Alright! Success!”
“I did it!”
I high-fived Krush, who was next to me.
“Awesome!”
May, who had been creating wind to keep the mist monsters at bay, hugged us both.
“It’s all thanks to you two. Thank you.”
“What are you talking about? Without Lord Salt, we wouldn’t have been able to do anything.”
“Exactly. Even if we had temporarily pushed them back, we wouldn’t have been able to save our comrades.”
The two exchanged glances and bowed their heads to me.
“I’ve been helped again. Thank you.”
“Thank you!”
“I’m really glad. More importantly, there’s something I want to discuss with you two.”
I had determined that Lady Rana’s symptoms were due to cursed poison during this expedition.
Cursed poison is when death attribute monsters create nests within the body, gradually eroding it.
If not purified with holy attributes, Lady Rana would surely die.
“Lady Rana!”
“Salt-san, please help Lady Rana!”
“Ah, I intend to do just that. So I’m thinking of hurrying back on horseback.”
“Leave the protection to me.”
“I want to go too, but I need to inform the members.
Plus, Krush is safer for protection than I am.
Krush, please take care of Salt-san.
Salt-san, please help Lady Rana!”
“Ah.”
I entrusted the cleanup to May and assigned the vice commander in the village to lead the members.
With Krush as my protector, I raced back to the Corias Territory with all my might.
Riding with urgency, I finally caught sight of the castle gates of the territory.
I needed to report immediately. I was worried about Lady Rana.
“Lord Salt! Lady Rana will be fine. Don’t panic.”
Krush spoke to me calmly, but I could tell she was also anxious; her grip on the reins was stronger than usual.
My heart was anything but calm.
This cursed poison was progressing faster and was more dangerous than I had anticipated.
If anything happened to Lady Rana, I would regret it endlessly.
“I know. But hurry, Krush. We don’t have much time!”
I urged my horse to go faster, heading toward Lady Rana.
Upon entering the castle, the usually quiet and peaceful atmosphere felt tense.
The members of the Fourth Knight Order, who were usually lively, were looking around with tense expressions.
It was clear that something was happening.
I hurried to Lady Rana’s office and knocked on the door. However, there was no response from inside.
“Lady Rana…?”
Anxiety tightened in my chest.
Just then, Aria appeared from down the hallway.
She was in her white coat, looking a bit flustered as she approached me.
“Salt… what are you doing?”
Aria shot me a cold glare as she spoke.
“I came to report to Lady Rana. The members collapsed due to the miasma’s influence. And… Lady Rana’s illness…”
As I explained the situation, Aria’s expression hardened even more.
She sighed and shook her head.
“Lady Rana is… currently resting in her room.
Her condition has rapidly worsened.
Even though I examine her every day, we still don’t know the cause.”
At her words, I tried to explain what I had discovered.
“Aria, where is Lady Rana? I might know the cause! Let me examine her. If I can help even a little…”
But Aria cut me off.
“That’s impossible.
If I, a healer of the healing attribute, can’t do anything, what can you, a holy attribute user, do?
Besides, it’s absolutely forbidden for you to examine her.
Lady Rana has a fear of men.
I’ll be keeping a close watch.
So don’t do anything unnecessary.”
For a moment, I hesitated at Aria’s cold words. However, I noticed that her body and voice were trembling.
“But, Aria! If this continues… Lady Rana’s life might be in danger. I have purification magic.”
“Enough already!”
Aria interrupted me sharply.
“No matter what you think, Lady Rana is my patient.
I don’t need your help.
Please go back to your room.
I’ll handle this.”
At that moment, hurried footsteps echoed from behind the door.
Freina rushed in, out of breath.
“Lord Salt! Aria! Lady Rana is—!”
Aria turned pale and immediately dashed toward Lady Rana’s bedroom.
I quickly followed, heading toward Lady Rana.
The sight of Lady Rana, her face turned purple and gasping for breath, was too painful to bear.
She lay on the bed, looking as if she might lose her life at any moment.
Aria desperately cast healing magic, but her complexion showed no signs of improvement.
On the contrary, Lady Rana seemed to suffer even more, her face contorting as she let out groans of pain.
I could see Freina and Krush’s hearts aching as they watched the scene.
While they were disturbed by Lady Rana’s condition, they were also watching over her with expressions of prayer.
However, the healing effects were nowhere to be seen, and Lady Rana’s suffering only increased.
“Why… why isn’t she getting better!”
Aria tried to strengthen her magic desperately, but the magic power glowing in her hands continued to weaken.
Yet, she continued the treatment without giving up, but it was clear to everyone that her limit was approaching.
In that moment, I made up my mind. If I did nothing here, Lady Rana wouldn’t be saved.
I had to act to save her, even if it meant risking my own life.
“Freina, please let me examine Lady Rana!”
I turned and spoke firmly to Freina.
“What are you saying, Salt! Lady Rana has a fear of men! Examining her is—”
Aria raised her voice in denial, but I pressed on.
“The cause of Lady Rana’s suffering is cursed poison.
It’s a toxin created by the miasma, and if this continues, she will lose her life.
I have the power to purify that cursed poison.
I’m the only one who can heal her.
Please… let me do it!”
At my words, Freina’s expression turned to one of confusion.
Aria glared at me even more fiercely, but then Krush stepped in.
“Freina, I believe him.
I didn’t know about Lady Rana’s condition, but her complexion is the same as the members who collapsed.”
Krush supported my words.
“What do you mean?”
Freina asked, but Aria interrupted.
“No! Salt! Have you forgotten that Lady Rana has a fear of men? If you intervene, it might worsen her fear!”
I understood that Aria was concerned for Lady Rana. However, I wouldn’t back down.
Lady Rana’s life was at stake. If I was the one who could save her, then I had to act.
While I was exchanging words with Aria, Krush explained the situation to Freina.
“Please, Lady Freina. If I don’t do this, Lady Rana will truly not be saved!”
Freina closed her eyes for a moment, deep in thought.
Then, seeing Lady Rana in pain, she made her decision.
“...Lord Salt, do it. Save Lady Rana.”
Aria tried to protest, but the one with the authority here was Freina.
I couldn’t go against Freina’s orders.
Aria bit her lip in frustration but quietly stepped back to a corner of the room.
I took a deep breath and approached Lady Rana’s side.
She lay on the bed, breathing faintly.
The moment I got closer, Lady Rana’s body twitched, clearly showing her fear.
“Lady Rana... It’s me, Salt. I will save you... Please, trust me.”
I spoke gently, hoping to ease her fear even a little.
“I will definitely... save you... So, please believe in me.”
I felt her frightened expression soften just a bit.
I touched her hand, feeling its warmth, and prepared the magic to purify the cursed poison with all my might.
However, I had exhausted my magic power before coming here. There was no time to recover it.
I resolved to convert my own life force into magic power.
“Lady Rana... I will definitely save your life!”
I spurred myself on, pouring all my strength into Lady Rana.
With the determination to sacrifice my own life, I used holy attribute magic to confront the cursed poison.
“Guh!”
The cursed poison nesting within Lady Rana was powerful, and its strength grew with each passing moment.
If I had realized it sooner, I wouldn’t have let Lady Rana suffer like this.
As I coughed up blood, I enveloped Lady Rana with holy attribute magic and pinpointed the location where the cursed poison was nesting.
There was a nest near her heart, and if I destroyed it in an instant, it might leave a hole in her heart as well.
I carefully eliminated the cursed poison.
“Buhah!”
“Lord Salt!”
“Lord Salt!”
Freina and Krush called out in concern. It wasn’t just from their mouths; blood was spilling from their eyes and ears.
Transforming my life force into magic power made my blood vessels feel as if they were boiling.
I could feel myself nearing my limit, yet I continued to fight without letting go.
The cursed poison nesting within Lady Rana fiercely resisted my magic, creating a tug-of-war.
The cursed poison, which had taken time to build its nest, was not something that could be easily purified; it sought to swallow my power.
However, I never gave up.
“I will definitely... absolutely save you!”
Finally, the cursed poison began to weaken gradually.
I felt my magic power overwhelm the cursed poison, purifying it little by little.
“Alright!”
But I couldn’t let my guard down yet.
I had to completely eliminate the cursed poison and heal the wounds.
In the final moment, I poured all my strength into it, and the cursed poison vanished completely.
Lady Rana’s complexion gradually returned to its original color.
Her body regained warmth and transformed into peaceful breathing.
“...Lady Rana...”
I finally released her hand and collapsed onto the floor.
